title: Geometric Generalization of Neural Operators from a Kernel Integral Perspective
summary: Neural operators are neural network-based surrogate models for approximating partial differential equation solution operators, enabling efficient many-query computations in science and engineering when low-to-moderate accuracy is sufficient. Many applications, including engineering design, involve variable and often nonparametric geometries, for which generalization to unseen shapes remains a central practical challenge.
